description: A big, lively cidery with lawn and upstairs patio seating, wood-fired pizza, and genuine non-alcoholic options on the menu.

name: Urban Distilleries
description: A downtown craft distillery and cocktail bar known for inventive drinks and a genuinely good Caesar.

name: Valoroso Foods West Kelowna
description: An Italian deli and market where staff help build a custom sandwich with samples along the way, plus directions to a great nearby picnic spot.

name: Van Westen Vineyards
description: A laid-back, family-run winery on the Aikins Loop where you can flip through vinyl records while you taste.

name: Vancouver Pizza Kitchen
description: A Rutland pizza shop known for Tandoori Chaap and other Indian-fusion toppings alongside the classics.

name: Ve Oh Lay Acres Winery & Farm
description: A family-friendly farm winery with expansive views, non-alcoholic options, tacos on site, and dogs genuinely welcome.

name: Vernon Golf & Country Club
description: A clubhouse restaurant with a beautiful patio and genuinely well-prepared food, though front-of-house service can be inconsistent.

name: Vice & Virtue Brewing Co.
description: A brewpub known for genuinely good gluten-free buns alongside its chef's-table beer pairing dinners.

name: Vietnam Village Restaurant
description: A small, cozy neighbourhood Vietnamese spot where the owner remembers regulars' usual orders.

name: Villages Pizza - Lower Mission
description: The Lower Mission location of the local pizza chain, known for a Wednesday wings-and-pizza combo deal.

name: Villages Pizza - West Kelowna
description: A West Kelowna pizza and wings spot known for its BBQ chicken pie and fast, friendly service.

name: Vineyard Kitchen & Patio at Nighthawk Vineyards
description: The restaurant at Nighthawk Vineyards on Green Lake, a small family-run operation with an inspired, locally-sourced menu that punches well above its size.

name: Vintners
description: The restaurant inside the Coast Capri Hotel, a reliable breakfast and brunch spot with plenty of gluten-free options and occasional live music.

name: Viva Mexicana
description: A cozy, authentic Winfield Plaza Mexican spot with real tortilla soup and generous kids' meals, run by a warm owner named Carmen.

name: Viva Mexicana Taco Bar
description: A Vernon Mexican market and taco stand with homemade tortillas and street-style tacos.

name: Volcanic Hills Estate Winery
description: A winery and bistro combo on Boucherie Road, known for a fun, interactive tasting laid out across the property.

name: WINGS Restaurants & Pubs - Kelowna
description: A sports-bar pub famous for its wing flavour lineup, popular on game nights.

name: WINGS Restaurants & Pubs - Penticton
description: The Penticton location of the wing-focused pub chain, with a surprisingly great kids menu and happy hour that impressed a family with a toddler.

name: WOK STAR RESTAURANT
description: A newer Szechuan takeout spot with big portions and friendly, fast service.

name: Wa Skew'r Sushi & Bar
description: A Japanese izakaya with skewers, sashimi, and a full sake list - a step beyond typical sushi-restaurant fare.

name: Ward's Wine Country Kitchen
description: A small chic restaurant inside the Oliver Wine Village, with patio bites and misters on hot days, plus water for visiting dogs.

name: Wasabi Ramen and Izakaya
description: A hidden-gem izakaya off Bernard Ave serving okonomiyaki alongside rich, authentic ramen broths.

name: Wasabi Sushi & Grill
description: A casual, food-court-style Vernon sushi spot with generous party trays and reasonable prices.

name: Waterfront Wines Restaurant
description: An award-winning wine bar and fine-dining spot, small and lively so it can get loud when busy, with a knowledgeable staff and thoughtful pairings.

name: Wayne & Freda
description: A bustling, dog-friendly patio cafe attached to a mercantile shop, right by the farmers market.

name: Wedge Cheesery
description: A Vernon cheese shop known for genuinely excellent charcuterie boards, with an owner who knows every cheesemaker she works with personally.

name: Wesbert Winery
description: A dog-friendly patio serving wood-fired pizza alongside low-intervention wines and panoramic lake views.

name: West Coast Seafood & Raw Bar Kelowna
description: A downtown seafood and raw bar with a patio, known for its generous cioppino and a lively $2.50 oyster happy hour.

name: West Sakura Teriyaki Restaurant
description: A neighbourhood West Kelowna sushi and teriyaki spot with generous bento boxes and no pressure to tip before you're ready.

name: Whiski-Jack's Pub
description: A longtime Westbank pub with a nice patio, pool tables, real live bands, and a solid happy hour after a day on the Smith Creek trails.

name: White Spot Kelowna Airport
description: The airport outpost of the well-known BC diner chain, with real gluten-free options, the most reliable option once you're past security.

name: Wild Ginger
description: A busy, beloved Chinese restaurant with a singing robot helper for birthdays and a well-loved breaded almond chicken.

name: Wild Goose Winery
description: A patio with mountain and vineyard views paired with a newly rebranded bistro putting out standout seasonal dishes.

name: Wildling
description: An elevated tasting-menu restaurant praised for genuinely accommodating vegetarian diners without watering down the experience.

name: Winfield Chinese Restaurant
description: A Winfield Chinese restaurant with big egg rolls and generous portions, though reviews on flavour consistency are mixed.

name: Wok Inn Restaurant
description: A Rutland Chinese takeout spot with generous family-meal combos, reviews are mixed but many regulars keep coming back for the value.

name: Wolf Tree Coffee
description: A true hidden-gem roastery tucked inside District Wine Village, with a devoted local following.

name: Wood Fire Bakery
description: An authentic German bakery-cafe with a beloved borscht and ham hock, generous portions and fair prices, open weekdays only from 11 to 3.
description_fr: Une authentique boulangerie-café allemande reconnue pour son bortsch et son jarret de jambon, avec des portions généreuses et des prix justes; ouvert seulement en semaine de 11 h à 15 h.

name: Wooden Nickel Cafe
description: A no-frills Lake Country breakfast stop known for its cinnamon buns and a friendly, unhurried vibe.

name: Woody's Pub
description: A Lake Country institution with a fast kitchen, a locals-only feel, and games playing on the TVs most nights.

name: Xing Yun
description: An airport-area Chinese and dim sum restaurant reviewers compare favourably to Vancouver and Richmond dim sum.

name: YLW Tacos
description: A hidden food-court taco counter with hand-pressed tortillas and house-made hot sauces at various spice levels, known for a standout sweet potato and pork belly taco.

name: Yaki's Pizza & Subs
description: A Summerland pizza-and-sub shop known for the Yakistix breadsticks and a menu bigger than most small-town pizzerias.

name: Yama Kitchen
description: A locally-owned Kelowna sushi spot regulars call the best-kept secret in town, known for generous sashimi bento lunches.

name: Yamas Taverna
description: A lively Greek taverna known for generous portions of roast lamb and calamari, with music that keeps the atmosphere upbeat.

name: Yamato - West Kelowna
description: A longtime West Kelowna favourite blending sushi with Vietnamese pho and laksa on the same menu.

name: Yellow Dog Brewing Co
description: A well-designed patio brewery with an all-day happy hour on Thursdays and a rotating wing special.

name: Yuki Sushi
description: A genuine hidden gem in Lumby, just outside Vernon, a cozy, family-feel sushi spot worth the short drive, with a standout vegetarian sushi platter.

name: YukiOn Sushi
description: A newly opened Vernon Japanese spot with a modern, clean interior, regulars already call it the best sushi in the Okanagan.

name: Yum Yum Tree
description: A fast, friendly mall-style Chinese counter with generous portions and consistently fresh food.

name: Yuzu Bowl and Bistro
description: A Japanese bistro that's genuinely welcoming to young kids, with a happy hour roll deal that's hard to beat.

name: Zabb Thai Restaurant
description: A consistently excellent Thai spot in Pandosy with a well-loved dinner-for-two preset menu.

name: Zen's Plant-Based Cuisine
description: A newly opened, entirely vegan restaurant with cashew Alfredo, mushroom bowls, and a complimentary tea or soy-milk coffee to start.

name: Zias Stonehouse Restaurant
description: A longtime local favourite with a patio widely called one of the best in the area, especially for the seafood feast.
description_fr: Un favori local de longue date dont la terrasse est largement considérée comme l'une des meilleures de la région, particulièrement pour le festin de fruits de mer.

name: barBURRITO
description: A fast-casual Tex-Mex burrito chain outlet, a reliable quick option for a filling lunch.

name: kettle valley pizza (Okanagan Falls)
description: A small, family-run OK Falls pizza shop with a game table for waiting and a poutine made with real curds, no mozzarella shortcuts.

name: maaza indian kitchen + Bar
description: A Vernon Indian restaurant and bar known for rich curries and a customizable butter chicken spice level.

name: reggaefusionfood
description: A UBCO-area food truck with genuinely good live music playing, known for jerk chicken poutine and a well-loved chickpea curry.

name: soe cafe
description: A pottery-filled, music-forward cafe with excellent matcha, natural wines, and vinyl for sale.
